message:
So FuzzTargetNg processes `.pcapng` files. The vulnerability is "Negative-size-param" found by ASAN. This is in the LightPcapNg library. Let me look at the LightPcapNg code, particularly the pcapng reading code, to find where a negative size parameter could be passed to a memory function like `memcpy` or `malloc`.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>ls /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus/3rdParty/LightPcapNg/LightPcapNg/src/ && echo "---" && grep -rn "memcpy\|memmove\|malloc\|realloc" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus/3rdParty/LightPcapNg/LightPcapNg/src/*.c | head -50</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
